name_reason: Compliant with data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention. domain=graphics (used by the filled-circle-band animation primitive), descriptor=circle_anim_div_10. The trailing _10 is the semantic constant value (the literal divisor 10.0 applied as the FDIV operand), NOT a Ghidra address residue -- the symbol address is 0x501f0, not 0x10. Name correctly reflects both role (divisor) and the constant it stores. No rename needed.
purpose: Fixed scalar divisor 10.0 used by fd2_render_circle_anim_row to scale the per-row half-width of the AoE filled-circle band animation.
logic_summary: Single read site (fd2_render_circle_anim_row @ 0x21a78). Per scanline inside the vertical extent of the circle, the function computes half_width = trunc(sqrt(r*r - dy*dy) * scale_num / 10.0); this constant is the /10.0 operand, loaded as an 8-byte double and applied via x87 FDIV. The conversion truncates toward zero (__CHP sets RC=round-toward-zero before FISTP), matching the emitted C (int) cast.
element_semantics: Scalar constant 10.0. Raw bytes 00 00 00 00 00 00 24 40 (LE) = 0x4024000000000000 = 10.0; matches C literal 10.0 byte-exact. Acts as the fixed denominator in the circle half-width scale expression.
notes: is_const=true: exactly one xref, a READ (no game-side writers). DataType in Ghidra confirmed 'double'; Ghidra symbol name byte-identical to src. Ghidra data PLATE_COMMENT was null (blank) -> created a concise plate (purpose+formula+mechanism+const+single-reader+src pointer) via run_script_inline (set verified by read-back). src comment block (gfxtab.c lines 10-18) already precise and matches the decompiled reader exactly, so kept unchanged (no Edit to gfxtab.c). run_script_inline's bundle log dumps unrelated previously-failing scripts; the actual script ran SUCCESSFULLY -- inline scripts here require bare statements with fully-qualified class names (no import lines, no class wrapper).
